notes: IMD Offsets is derived from the MIT-licensed ADAM repository. LaunchToken in src/LaunchToken.sol has no constructor arguments; IMDOToken inherits it and is the alias used by the manual script. Requested chain context is 11155111 (Sepolia); chain selection is external to this manifest. Ethereum mainnet (1) is the real target, deployed manually from this repo. The required manager and IMD literals both have empty code on Sepolia at block 11858333 (eth_getCode). Constructors permit deployment without these dependencies, but process() reverts PoolUnavailable before allocating ETH. Funds sent there remain unsplit with no rescue withdrawal. The chain/dependency mismatch remains unresolved; this is not an operational Sepolia deployment and must not be funded. Contracts are in constructor dependency order. Because later contracts cannot be referenced, claim, regenSafe, offsetsSafe and opsWallet all resolve to policy $owner. That address alone can stakeFor, withdraw notified REGEN ETH to itself, set the REGEN cap within its bounds, and pull operations and retirement balances. Trust assumption: because every stakeFor restarts the beneficiary's 24-hour lock, that address can keep any staker's principal locked by staking 1 wei for them each day; the manual deployment avoids this by making ImdoClaim the only stakeFor caller, and it stakes only for msg.sender. These roles are immutable; a later ImdoClaim cannot replace the staking claim caller. The policy owner is excluded from staking. ImdoHook and ImdoClaim are script-only. The hook's launch fee is 20% flat until its owner calls open(), then decays to 1.5% over 30 minutes; a swap never starts that clock. script/DeployImdo.s.sol creates a separate complete deployment with the predicted claim address, a mined hook, one single-sided position with a 890,000,000 IMDO budget and LP NFT sent to dead, 110,000,000 IMDO for claims, and two-step hook ownership transfer. The factory supplies its own allocation, MerkleDistributor and initialization-only pool guard; its pool does not route trade fees to this treasury. No initialization calls are specified here. Pool fee 3000, spacing 60 and nominal sqrtPriceX96 79228162514264337593543950336 retain the supplied manifest defaults; the manual opening tick is a script argument. Treasury buys IMD from ETH/IMD fee 10000, spacing 200, no hooks; maximum buy 1 ETH, slippage 300 bps, cooldown 600 seconds. Anyone may process. A 50 bps bounty applies only to newly processed ETH; net splits are 1000/2500/2500/4000 bps to operations, ecological-credit retirement, REGEN and IMD. Processing is capped; excess stays unsplit. REGEN accrual is capped at 0.5 ETH per timestamp/7-day epoch, adjustable only by regenSafe within 0.05-5 ETH. Overflow joins IMD immediately; failed REGEN notifications remain pending for retry. Purchases halve retries without rerouting. After each buy the min-out checkpoint may only rise, by at most 200 bps of sqrt-price above the enforced floor scaled by the buy's size, and the decay anchor moves only on a true rise: a sandwich cannot ratchet the floor down, repeated dust buys cannot ratchet it up, and the floor decays no faster than the documented 7-day hyperbola; a sustained IMD rise faster than the decay delays buys until it catches up. Claims pay IMD, never ETH. REGEN credits are lifetime records; the safe handles off-chain purchases and distribution, and withdrawals cannot exceed notified ETH. Every stake resets the 24-hour lock.
